item.title: National Weather Service Paducah discusses spring severe weather preparedness
item.description: PADUCAH, Ky., (KBSI) — The National Weather Service in Paducah hosted a livestream discussing ways residents can prepare for the upcoming spring severe weather season. Forecasters shared safety tips and preparedness information aimed at helping communities respond to potential severe weather events during the spring months.
